subject: Private Offer: acceleration request & drawdown ops runbook
messages:
From: Elena Park <elenap@orionanalytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer commit - request to accelerate drawdown & onboarding

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the walk-through yesterday. After an internal planning sync, our leadership is asking whether we can accelerate the drawdown on our GCP private offer for Q3. We originally committed $400k for the next 12 months, but our product roadmap shifted and we anticipate consuming ~50% of that in the next 60 days if we can get faster provisioning and the billing alignment.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood support a front-loaded drawdown schedule (partial acceleration) so we can access more units sooner?
- What operational steps do we need to get billing/invoicing aligned with GCP private offer mechanics so our finance team can process early consumption?

I've attached a short consumption snapshot (Q2) and the initial list of SKUs we plan to use. We're ready to sign an amendment if needed, but would prefer an ops-runbook we can follow so procurement/billing teams have a clear checklist.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Cloud, Orion Analytics
elena.park@orionanalytics.com

Attachments: orion_consumption_q2.pdf (PDF, 234KB)

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer commit - request to accelerate drawdown & onboarding

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the details and the consumption snapshot. We can support an accelerated drawdown but there are a few cross-functional steps to make it smooth (billing, SKU mapping in the marketplace, and a short amendment for the commitment timing).

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Intake form from Orion so our Partner Ops team can map SKUs and confirm marketplace fulfillment — I attached a short intake doc.
2) Sales (Marissa) to confirm commercial approval for any front-loaded drawdown and surface any discounting implications.
3) Partner Ops (Jonas) to propose an adjusted drawdown timetable and billing cadence we can hand to GCP and Orion Finance.

Marissa/Jonas — can you confirm availability next week for a 30-minute ops sync (I can run it)? Elena, please fill out the attached intake_form_gcp_pvt.docx and I'll circulate the proposed runbook after the sync.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee

Thanks — looping in my commercial side.

Marissa here. From a sales/contract perspective we can greenlight a partial front-load to cover the next 60 days (targeting ~$200k of committed units frontloaded), provided:
- We document the amended drawdown schedule as an addendum to the existing private offer.
- Orion Finance confirms the invoice timing they prefer (monthly vs net30 milestone invoice).
- Pricing stays intact for the portion accelerated (no retroactive changes).

I've drafted a proposed timetable (attached) with a phased burn: 40% in month 1, 20% in month 2, remainder spread across months 3–6. That reduces operational risk while giving Orion runway.

Ops asks for Partner/Billing:
- Confirm whether GCP will accept a modified SKU allocation for a frontloaded redemption. If not, we use our vendor-side invoice smoothing.
- If an amendment is required, Legal will need ~3 business days to approve once wording is final.

I'll coordinate with Procurement on Orion's billing preference after the sync.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Director, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: proposed_drawdown_timetable.xlsx (XLSX, 62KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elenap@orionanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer commit - request to accelerate drawdown & onboarding

Quick notes from Partner Ops / Billing perspective:

1) Two viable mechanisms to achieve accelerated access:
   - Marketplace amendment / addendum: GCP flow where we submit an amendment to the private offer to re-phase redemptions. This requires GCP partner team review and ~5 business days to reflect in the ledger.
   - Vendor-side pre-invoice + settlement: Redwood invoices Orion for the frontloaded units and we reconcile against marketplace redemptions over the commit period. Faster (1–2 business days) but requires internal PO/invoice acceptance from Orion.

2) SKU mapping: the attached billing_runbook.pdf explains mapping steps. For frontload we recommend locking the SKU set for the accelerated tranche to avoid unexpected reclassification during redemption.

3) Risk & controls: If we go vendor-invoice first, include a 60-day reconciliation clause and a credit mechanism in case consumption differs materially. Legal will need to sign off.

Action items:
- Marissa: confirm commercial approval for vendor-invoice fallback if GCP amendment timing is too slow.
- Aditya (Finance): can you confirm whether Orion's procurement team typically accepts vendor pre-invoices for marketplace commitments?
- Soojin: schedule the ops sync and share the intake form results.

Jonas Weber
Partner Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Attachment: billing_runbook.pdf (PDF, 180KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elenap@orionanalytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer commit - request to accelerate drawdown & onboarding

Elena / team —

Thanks for moving quickly on the intake. Based on the sync and internal checks, here's the agreed runbook to accelerate access while keeping controls:

1) Short-term (fast path, target completion by 2026-07-23): vendor-side pre-invoice for $200k to be issued by Redwood once Orion confirms PO acceptance. This unlocks credits and gives Orion immediate usage ability.
2) Parallel (marketplace path, target completion by 2026-07-30): submit an amendment to the GCP private offer to re-phase redemptions to match the frontload; GCP partner team will reconcile ledger entries and we will net settle differences.
3) Reconciliation: 60-day reconciliation window; any over/under consumption is credit-adjusted monthly.
4) Legal & Billing: Redwood Legal will prepare a one-page amendment + 60-day reconciliation clause; billing to generate vendor pre-invoice on receipt of Orion PO.

Action items & owners:
- Elena / Orion: confirm PO acceptance for vendor pre-invoice (reply to this thread) — owner: Orion Procurement
- Marissa: confirm commercial approval for the $200k pre-invoice and sign the amendment when Legal sends it — owner: Sales
- Aditya: stand by to approve invoice flow and confirm internal GL mapping — owner: Finance
- Jonas: submit the GCP amendment and run SKU lock steps if GCP requests them — owner: Partner Ops

Links & docs: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/deal/87321; Amendment draft (to be shared via DocuSign): https://docusign.example/envelope/ABCD1234

If Orion confirms PO acceptance by EOD tomorrow we'll issue the pre-invoice and aim to have the amendment in GCP the following week. Thanks everyone — will follow up with Legal draft and a brief checklist.

Soojin Lee
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
